method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Equities: Stocks pressured by higher yields and energy risks - Deutsche Bank
Equities.summary: Deutsche Bank strategists notes that the S&P 500 slipped as geopolitical developments and higher yields pressured sentiment. Energy outperformed while industrials and materials lagged.
Equities.reason: Clear market-level signal: higher yields and geopolitical/energy risk are described as weighing on the S&P — a negative for broad equities and risk sentiment. Relevance is elevated because it ties macro (yields) and geopolitics into market positioning.

Equities.title: S&P 500, Dow futures muted ahead of jobs data; chips, software stocks rise
Equities.reason: Market-wide positioning ahead of key macro data (jobs) usually produces muted/neutral trading; slight negative tilt as uncertainty can damp risk-taking. Lower relevance because it's a short-term positioning note rather than a regime shift.

Equities.title: Global equity funds draw inflows for 11th week as upbeat earnings lift sentiment
Equities.reason: Sustained inflows (11th week) plus upbeat earnings create a broad, constructive liquidity/earnings backdrop for equities — a meaningful bullish cross-market narrative. High relevance for market regime and positioning.

Equities.title: BofA sentiment gauge hits most extreme bullish level since 2021
Equities.reason: Extreme bullish retail/manager sentiment suggests froth and potential near-term vulnerability for equities (contrarian signal). Relevant as a risk indicator but not a deterministic market mover.

Equities.title: Google’s AI shake-up boosts Brin as DeepMind’s Hassabis steps aside
Equities.summary: Silicon Valley parent consolidates control as the London lab’s scientific culture gives way to urgency to build AI products
Equities.reason: Major tech/AI leadership change signals corporate prioritisation of productisation and speed — supportive for AI/tech leadership stocks and the broader equity narrative around AI-driven earnings growth.

Equities.title: ByteDance targets mega AI model nearing Anthropic’s Mythos
Equities.summary: TikTok owner training a model three times larger than Moonshot’s Kimi K3
Equities.reason: Another large-cap technology firm ramping AI capability reinforces the dominant equity theme of AI leadership and demand for compute — supportive for tech sector multiples and earnings expectations.

Equities.title: SK Hynix to invest $38 billion building new memory chip plants as demand soars
Equities.summary: Memory prices have surged because of short supply and huge demand with investors watching closely for any changes to the supply-demand imbalance.
Equities.reason: Substantial capex by a major memory supplier signals strong secular demand from AI and data-centre markets — bullish for semis and related equities, and supportive of earnings/capex narratives.

Equities.title: Stocks close lower as investors eye Mideast talks, earnings
Equities.reason: Geopolitical negotiations in the Middle East are cited as a near-term market headwind that knocked stocks lower — reinforces the risk-off/geopolitics theme that offsets parts of the positive earnings/AI flow.

Equities.title: Airbnb stock soars 9% on earnings and revenue beat, strong guidance for third quarter
Equities.summary: Airbnb said it's seeing strong demand "across all regions," contributing to the company's better-than-expected forecast.
Equities.reason: Example of earnings upside translating into outsized stock moves and supporting the broader 'earnings lift' narrative; relevant but single-company signal so lower relevance.

Rates.title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
Rates.reason: FOMC statements are a primary driver of Treasury yield expectations. Late‑July wording pointing to a higher‑for‑longer stance keeps upward pressure on yields (negative for bond prices) and materially shapes rate markets.

Rates.title: (BOJ Review) Impact of the Bank of Japan's Reductions in JGB Purchases on the JGB Markets
Rates.reason: BOJ research explicitly linking reductions in JGB purchases to JGB market dynamics signals a policy-driven reduction in central‑bank demand. Lower official demand is a clear upward pressure on yields (negative for bonds) and is highly relevant for global rates.

Rates.title: The curious case of the Japanese government bond yields
Rates.summary: Maybe not as high as you think
Rates.reason: FT analysis on JGB yields provides market colour/interpretation around recent moves. It reinforces the narrative of rising/re‑priced JGB yields, a negative impulse for bond prices though less primary than official BOJ notices.

Rates.title: Quarterly Schedule of Outright Purchases of Japanese Government Bonds (Competitive Auction Method) (July-September 2026) (Schedule Updates)
Rates.reason: Updated BOJ purchase schedules are operational signals of changing central‑bank support for the JGB market. Reductions or re‑scheduling weigh on bond demand and push yields higher (negative for rates).

Rates.title: Top Japan Insurer Urges Companies to Issue Bonds in Yield Hunt
Rates.reason: Insurance sector demand for higher-yield paper highlights a market operating in a higher‑yield equilibrium and is consistent with broader repricing in fixed income. Market signalling is negative for existing bond prices (yields elevated) though primarily a corporate‑credit angle.

Rates.title: Bond Traders Look to Jobs Data That May Tip Scale on Fed Hike
Rates.reason: Piece highlights market sensitivity to US payrolls for the Fed path. Strong jobs risking further hikes raises expectations for higher yields (negative for bonds); high relevance for near‑term rates positioning.

Rates.title: US Nonfarm Payrolls set to rebound in July as markets reassess Fed rate path
Rates.summary: The United States (US) Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) is set to release the Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) data for July on Friday at 12:30 GMT.
Rates.reason: NFP previews feed directly into Fed rate expectations and near‑term Treasury moves. Anticipation of a stronger print supports a higher‑for‑longer narrative (negative for bonds) with moderate relevance.

Rates.title: Statement on Monetary Policy
Rates.reason: BOJ monetary policy statement is a core driver of JGB expectations. Any language reflecting a gradual withdrawal of support or normalization pushes yields up (negative for bonds) and materially influences global rates.

Rates.title: Bank Rate maintained at 3.75% - July 2026 Monetary Policy Summary and Minutes
Rates.summary: The Bank of England’s Monetary Policy Committee is responsible for making decisions about Bank Rate.
Rates.reason: A hold in Bank Rate (3.75%) signals a pause versus further hikes; from a gilt perspective this is mildly supportive for bond prices (slightly lower yields). Relevance is moderate since it is a routine MPC outcome.

FX.title: Yen rally fades a week after U.S.-Japan intervention as focus shifts to policy
FX.summary: The coordinated involvement from the Treasury and BoJ had initially lifted the yen as low as 155 to the dollar, down from just above 163 beforehand.
FX.reason: Major coordinated US–Japan intervention initially supported JPY but the rally has faded — reinforces a market narrative that intervention effects can be short-lived and that USD strength is reasserting vs JPY. High relevance because of direct, high-profile intervention.

FX.title: Yen Surrenders Nearly Half Its Gains from US-Japan Intervention
FX.reason: Confirms that much of the intervention-led JPY appreciation has reversed — supports dominant USD strength / JPY weakness narrative and signals the intervention was not fully durable. Medium-high relevance as it reinforces a market-wide FX development.

FX.title: Japanese Yen holds onto weekly losses amid absence of US-Japan intervention follow-up
FX.summary: The Japanese Yen (JPY) has underperformed its major currency peers this week due to a lack of follow-up joint intervention by the United States (US) and Japan.
FX.reason: Direct FX-native report: absence of follow-up intervention leaves JPY on the back foot, consistent with USD/JPY upside. Relevant to USD-driven FX flows and positioning.

FX.title: US Dollar: Labour market still solid – Danske Bank
FX.summary: Danske Research Team expects United States (US) Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) to rise by 70k in July, with the unemployment rate steady at 4.2% and average hourly earnings up 0.3% m/m.
FX.reason: Macro signal: a solid US labour market supports Fed policy expectations and USD strength into NFP — directly USD-centric and market-relevant.

FX.title: NFP or Iran: Which factor will break the US Dollar Index out of its consolidation?
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY) trades around 99.95 at the time of writing on Friday, virtually unchanged on the day, as investors refrain from placing aggressive bets ahead of the release of the July US employment report.
FX.reason: DXY-focused piece showing consolidation ahead of NFP — low-info, near-term event risk dominated; scores small negative to reflect slight USD-strength bias from event positioning.

FX.title: Swiss Franc: Funding currency weakness extends – OCBC
FX.summary: OCBC’s Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong note the Swiss Franc (CHF) remains under pressure as carry trade funding demand grows and recent Japanese Yen (JPY) intervention reinforces CHF’s role as a preferred funding currency.
FX.reason: CHF described as a funding currency under pressure — reinforces a cross-currency funding/positioning theme that supports USD/CHF upside and broader USD strength vs funding currencies.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar: Labour resilience favours CAD against US Dollar – TD Securities
FX.summary: TD Securities strategists expect Canada’s July Jobs Report to confirm ongoing labour market strength, with employment rising another 20k, matching consensus and extending the recovery of 2026 job losses.
FX.reason: CAD-specific macro: resilient Canadian labour market is a direct USD-negative (CAD strength) signal for USD/CAD flows. Moderate relevance as it counters the USD-strength theme in one major commodity currency.

FX.title: US euro sale to prop up yen blindsided ECB
FX.summary: Christine Lagarde and Scott Bessent spoke only after Washington’s historic intervention
FX.reason: Reports that US action (selling euros to support the yen) created cross-border FX tensions — important for market structure and coordination. Ambiguous directionality but leans toward continued USD/FX repricing and short-term USD strength vs intervention-impacted pairs.

Commodities.title: China’s Central Bank Adds 20 Tons to Gold Reserves in July
Commodities.reason: Direct central-bank gold accumulation increases structural demand for gold, supporting prices and the bullion complex; material signal for commodities (gold).

Commodities.title: China's crude oil imports fell in the second quarter
Commodities.summary: China, the world's largest importer of crude oil, imported less crude oil in the second quarter of 2026 (2Q26) following higher crude oil prices that resulted from disrupted flows through the Strait of Hormuz. China's lower imports reduced global demand, softe
Commodities.reason: Lower Chinese crude imports reduce physical demand for oil — bearish for prices and relevant to the oil market demand picture.

Commodities.reason: Historical note that lower crude prices reduced trade value — mild negative signal for oil price backdrop but limited immediacy.

Commodities.title: Copper: Near record highs on tight supply – ING
Commodities.summary: ING’s Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey report Copper trading comfortably above $14,000/t, close to record highs, supported by tariff-related stockpiling into the US and tight physical markets elsewhere. They flag low inventories, constrained mine supply and on
Commodities.reason: Tight physical markets, low inventories and constrained mine supply are a clear bullish fundamental driver for copper prices.

Commodities.title: The U.S.-Canada natural gas and electricity trade value rose in 2025
Commodities.summary: Although the total value of energy trade between the United States and Canada fell by 11% in 2025 to an estimated $137 billion, according to data from the U.S. Census Bureau, the trade value of natural gas and electricity between the two countries increased sl
Commodities.reason: Rising US-Canada natural gas trade indicates firmer cross-border demand and flows for natural gas — supportive for gas fundamentals.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecasts: XAG/USD bulls are eroding resistance at the $63.30 area
Commodities.summary: Silver (XAG/USD) resumes its near-term bullish trend on Friday, after a brief hesitation on Thursday, reaching fresh six-week highs at $63.90, although it is still due to confirm the break of the resistance area at $63.30.
Commodities.reason: Near-term technical breakout and bullish momentum for silver — relevant but price-forecast/technical piece limits relevance.

Commodities.title: Gold heads for best week since January; US jobs data in focus
Commodities.reason: Gold hitting strongest weekly performance points to a stronger gold bid, likely driven by macro risk and Fed-rate/payroll expectations — positive for the precious metals complex.

Commodities.title: Oil Extends Gains as Iran Strikes Targets in Strait of Hormuz
Commodities.reason: Direct strikes and disruption at the Strait of Hormuz represent acute supply-risk to global oil flows — materially bullish for oil prices and market risk premium.

Commodities.title: Gulf’s ‘Little Sparta’ takes on the oil world
Commodities.summary: After leaving Opec, the UAE is backing state-oil company Adnoc to set a more assertive and expansive course
Commodities.reason: UAE pursuing a more assertive production/market-share strategy (and leaving OPEC) implies potential incremental supply or policy divergence — modestly bearish for oil.

Commodities.title: Iran's chief negotiator accuses Trump of 'theater diplomacy' with Hormuz traffic near standstill
Commodities.summary: The conflict is broadening across the region, with Gulf energy infrastructure and key shipping chokepoints under renewed threat.
Commodities.reason: Widening regional conflict and threats to Gulf energy infrastructure/shipping chokepoints heighten oil supply-risk — supportive for oil and energy risk premia.

Commodities.title: Oil rises as Iran's draft plan sees U.S. and Israel banned from Strait of Hormuz
Commodities.summary: News of Iran's restrictive draft plan for the Strait of Hormuz sent oil prices higher, renewing concerns over supply disruptions.
Commodities.reason: Policy moves restricting transit through a major choke point increase the risk of supply disruptions — clear bullish impulse for oil.

Commodities.title: Oil: Volatile range trading outlook – Rabobank
Commodities.summary: Rabobank’s Joe DeLaura details how renewed United States (US)–Iran tensions and disruptions at the Strait of Hormuz have driven a sharp rally and subsequent correction in Brent and West Texas Intermediate (WTI).
Commodities.reason: Market commentary flags heightened volatility from geopolitical tensions — modestly positive to oil risk premium but framed as range-bound volatility.

Commodities.title: Gold to reach $5,000 in first half of 2027, UBS says
Commodities.reason: Analyst price target for gold is bullish but is a forward-looking forecast (price-forecast piece), so relevance is capped despite support for the bullish narrative.

Crypto.reason: Institutionalization / market-making buildout: a major crypto market maker gaining broker-dealer capabilities suggests deeper liquidity and stronger institutional linkages — modestly positive for crypto market structure and flows.

Crypto.title: JPMorgan says Hyperliquid ETF inflows have stalled as competition mounts
Crypto.reason: Stalled ETF inflows into a major product are a small negative for BTC demand dynamics and highlight crowding/competition in ETF flows.

Crypto.reason: Major payment network integrating stablecoin rails is a strong adoption/utility signal for crypto payments and stablecoin demand — materially positive for the ecosystem.

Crypto.reason: Large on-chain movement tied to a vendor/operational issue raises short-term selling/liquidity risk for BTC and is a meaningful negative supply-side event.

Crypto.title: Ethereum staking token weETH splits from restaking as rewards debate heats up
Crypto.reason: Protocol-level fragmentation and governance dispute around restaking/rewards is a negative for ETH staking composability and adds sector-specific uncertainty.

Crypto.title: A bitcoin pattern taking shape right now could send prices soaring to $76,000
Crypto.reason: Technical/price-projection piece — limited fundamental signal but mildly positive for short-term bullish sentiment (relevance capped due to technical nature).

Crypto.title: Senate won't vote on crypto Clarity Act before its summer break
Crypto.reason: Delay in legislative clarity is a negative for regulatory certainty; postponing a key vote prolongs policy risk for the crypto sector.

Crypto.title: Tether expands tokenization business into Saudi Arabia, starting with real estate
Crypto.reason: Geographic expansion of tokenization services by a major stablecoin issuer indicates institutionalization and new demand channels for tokenized assets — positive adoption signal.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin, ether benefit as traders seek safety of largest tokens
Crypto.reason: Intra-crypto risk-off flows into BTC/ETH bolster demand for the largest tokens and reflect a concentration of liquidity in blue-chip crypto assets.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin developers flag 85 critical bugs in an "extremely bad" situation
Crypto.reason: Major technical/security risk: a large number of critical bugs in Bitcoin's codebase represents an exceptional negative for network reliability and market confidence.

Crypto.title: S&P 500 added all of crypto's $2 trillion market cap in a month while bitcoin barely moved. Here's why
Crypto.reason: Relative underperformance vs equities highlights capital allocation away from crypto and is a negative signal for near-term inflows.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin steadies above $64,000 as traders watch $100 billion SpaceX unlock
Crypto.reason: Large off-chain unlock tied to a major company can create selling pressure and inject short-term uncertainty into BTC price dynamics.
